regions.label: MZ header
regions.note: DOS EXE header, rebuilt by the museum unpacker after removing the DIET compression.

regions.label: Relocation table
regions.note: 7 segment addresses that DOS patches with the real load address.

regions.label: Header padding
regions.note: Fills the header to a 16-byte boundary.

regions.label: Borland C++ start-up code
regions.note: Sets up memory, the stack, argv and the environment, then calls main at 0525.

regions.label: C helpers
regions.note: Find first and find next in one function (AH = 4Eh + flag), set the DTA, compare names.

regions.label: Folder scanner
regions.note: Walks every folder (unless /NS) and checks each COM and EXE file it finds.

regions.label: main
regions.note: Reads /NS, /NC and /H, runs the memory check, scans the disk and prints the totals.

regions.label: Reopen for writing
regions.note: Closes the file, unlocks it if it is read-only, and opens it again for writing, so protected programs get cleaned too.

regions.label: Memory check and freeze
regions.note: Asks INT 21h AX=FF0Ch; on the reply C0C1h it sounds a siren and points INT 21h back at DOS through INT 3.

regions.label: Memory alarm messages
regions.note: "Found --KoKo (1) virus-- active in RAM", "Virus Freezed" and the advice to reboot from a clean disk, then a 1-byte flag.

regions.label: Message printer
regions.note: Prints message n from two pointer tables, with the file name in between.

regions.label: Zero bytes
regions.note: 120 zero bytes and a $.

regions.label: Message pointer tables
regions.note: Two tables of 10 word pointers, at CS:0A81 (before the file name) and CS:0A95 (after it).

regions.label: Scan messages
regions.note: "File is infected by KoKo (1) virus", "Virus removed", "Strange signeture", "Scanning >>", "Cleaning >>" and error texts.

regions.label: COM check and repair
regions.note: Checks bytes 5-25 and body+127h, writes back the 26 saved bytes and restores the date and time.

regions.label: EXE check and repair
regions.note: Checks SP = C0C1h and three body signatures, restores CS:IP and SS:SP, computes the clean size.

regions.label: Help routine
regions.note: Prints the three help pages (/H), waiting for a key after each.

regions.label: Help pages
regions.note: Version notes, credits (Yasser Mohamed Ali, Ebrahim El-Etr), the Koko description, and a contact page that this site does not reproduce.

regions.label: Press-any-key routine
regions.note: Prints the prompt, waits for a key, clears the line.

regions.label: Prompts
regions.note: "< Press any key >" and a blank line.

regions.label: Borland C++ runtime library
regions.note: printf, sprintf, chsize, file and memory functions that the compiler linked in.

regions.label: Runtime data
regions.note: The Borland copyright string, "Divide error" and start-up variables.

regions.label: Messages of the C part
regions.note: Path formats, "Scanning >> %s", the banner "KEMYAM Virus Capture. (Ver 1.05)", totals and usage.

regions.label: Spare string
regions.note: The text "a:format.com".

regions.label: File buffers
regions.note: A 26-byte header buffer at DS:0511 and a 98-byte body buffer at DS:052F.

regions.label: Koko COM signature
regions.note: push ax / mov ax,100h / push ax / xor ax,ax / retf / 08 00 "KoKo (1)" 0A 0D $: 21 bytes, compared with file bytes 5-25.

regions.label: Spaces
regions.note: 13 spaces after the signature string.

regions.label: Koko EXE signature
regions.note: 20 bytes of Koko's own EXE restore code, compared at entry + 5F0h.

regions.label: Koko restore-code signature
regions.note: BF 00 01 BE 22 01 (mov di,100h / mov si,122h), compared at body + 127h.

regions.label: Runtime data
regions.note: File table, buffers and other variables of the Borland runtime.

routines.name: find_koko_in_memory
routines.note: Detects Koko through its own reply, then cuts it off from DOS.

lines.note: Asks the question only Koko answers
Prints the alarm through INT 3, past the virus
AX=3503h through INT 3: read entry 3, the real DOS address
AX=2521h through INT 3: point INT 21h back at DOS

routines.name: check_and_clean_com
routines.note: Two signature checks, then the 26 saved bytes go back to the start of the file.

lines.note: Bytes 5-25 must match Koko's stub and name
Body + 127h must be Koko's restore code
Writes the 26 saved bytes at offset 0
Puts the date and time back

routines.name: check_and_clean_exe
routines.note: Finds Koko's mark in the EXE header and restores the original start-up fields.

lines.note: IP, SP, CS and SS come back from the virus body
Pages = size / 512, plus 1 for the last part

routines.name: find_file
routines.note: One helper for both find first and find next.
